question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rushes through**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Rushes through**' refers to moving quickly or hurriedly through a space or an activity. (किसी स्थान या गतिविधि के माध्यम से तेज़ी से या तेज़ी से आगे बढ़ने को संदर्भित करता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *Late for a meeting, he rushes through the crowded streets, weaving through the pedestrians with determination.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "**rushes through**" is appropriate because it conveys the idea that when the person arrives at a famous city, they move quickly through it.
 
• It implies a desire to quickly cover the main points of interest without lingering or spending too much time.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comes across**: Encountering or finding something or someone unexpectedly. (अप्रत्याशित रूप से किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति से मुठभेड़ या मिलना)
 
• **Browses through**: Examining or looking casually through items, content, or information without a specific goal or agenda. (वस्तुओं की आकस्मिक रूप से जांच करना या देखना)
 
• **Visits**: Going to a place, person, or website for a specific purpose, often to spend time or engage in an activity. (किसी विशिष्ट उद्देश्य से किसी स्थान, व्यक्ति या वेबसाइट पर जाना)
